Overview

content_blocks.text: General rules:
heading_path: Methods for calculating the estimated value of procurement
Overview

content_blocks.text: This regulation establishes general rules for determining the estimated value of procurement contracts, which must include all payable amounts including VAT as estimated by the contracting authority.
heading_path: Methods for calculating the estimated value of procurement
Overview

content_blocks.text: Subdividing a procurement with the effect of preventing it from falling within the scope of Part 2 of the PCR 2015 is not permitted unless there are objective justifications.
heading_path: Methods for calculating the estimated value of procurement
Overview

content_blocks.text: The estimated value of a procurement should be calculated either when the call for competition is submitted or when the procurement procedure begins.
heading_path: Methods for calculating the estimated value of procurement
Overview

content_blocks.text: The regulation also clarifies how the value of specific types of contracts must be determined.
heading_path: Methods for calculating the estimated value of procurement
Overview

content_blocks.text: Treatment of lots:
heading_path: Methods for calculating the estimated value of procurement
Overview

content_blocks.text: When contracts may be awarded in separate lots, the total estimated value of all lots should be used as the estimated total contract value. However, contracting authorities may award contracts for individual lots if the value of the lot falls below certain thresholds.
heading_path: Methods for calculating the estimated value of procurement
Overview

content_blocks.text: Objective at this commercial stage
heading_path: Methods for calculating the estimated value of procurement
Objective at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: The value of the contract to be procured needs to be determined according to this regulation (i.e. regulation 6) because above-threshold contracts must comply with Part 2 PCR, in particular with respect to the provision of standstill letters and publication of contract award notices.
heading_path: Methods for calculating the estimated value of procurement
Objective at this commercial stage
